'''Kruus Toran''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="RPG2" />

==Behind the scenes==
In ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game, Second Edition, Revised and Expanded]]'', Kruss Toran's name was spelled as Kruss '''Tran'''.<ref name="TRG">''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game, Second Edition, Revised and Expanded]]''</ref>
